svg.title: SlidePoise system architecture
svg.desc: Human and Codex author the brief, Profiles, Library Sets and shared frame. Image generation explores the content canvas. The Agent interprets meaningful objects, OpenCV measures assigned pixels, and the compiler reconstructs native PowerPoint with original assets. The Agent reviews actual renders and revises designs or objects.
svg.text: How a design becomes an editable deck
Codex plans the content and judges the design. Local tools reconstruct the chosen composition in PowerPoint.
Revise the design or individual objects
Compare PowerPoint renders with the chosen designs.
Refine shared typography, colour and spacing across the deck.
Revise or reorder individual slides, then review the complete deck.
